The '''''IF-120'' landing craft''', also known as '''Imperial Landing Force ship''', was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] for [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttling]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and providing support. Much larger than other craft of its type, the IF-120 was designed to serve as a mobile command base after landing. The IF-120 saw use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], including on an expedition to rediscover the lost world of [[Seoul 5]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:LandingForceShip.jpg|thumb|left|An IF-120 landing craft]]
The IF-120 landing craft was designed to serve as a [[Troop transport/Legends|troop transport]], taking soldiers from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] [[Planet/Legends|planetside]]. The design was based on the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class]] and [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class]] shuttles; but instead of having those models' folding wings, it had repulsors for stability. It had a much larger capacity&mdash;each IF-120 could hold up to 120 troops along with eight crew, 12 [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], two [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|LAVr QH-7 Chariot]] [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] and a [[PX-4 Mobile Command Base]]&mdash;and was bulkier than other landing craft, and possessed extensive communications and sensor systems. After landing and deploying its troops and vehicles, the IF-120's interior could convert from transport configuration into a fully-functional mobile command base until the area was secured for larger and more permanent command facilities. Each IF-120 was also armed with double medium [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and four antipersonnel heavy [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]].<ref name="GAW" />

==History==
Designed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], the IF-120 landing craft saw use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a troop transport during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="GAW" /> One such landing craft was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Drezzel]] on a mission to discover the ancient lost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seoul 5]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], not long after the Empire's climactic [[Battle of Endor/Legends|defeat]] at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Although the Imperial mission ultimately touched down upon Seoul 5, the ship and its crew were destroyed by a massive explosion of [[Seoularian crystal]]s triggered by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] hero [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="Marvel 84" />

==Behind the scenes==
The IF-120 landing craft first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 84|''Star Wars'' (1977) 84]], written by [[Roy Richardson]], illustrated by [[David Mazzucchelli]] and released in [[1984]].<ref name="Marvel 84" /> Originally unidentified, its name was provided 25 years later in the [[2009]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Galaxy at War]]''.<ref name="GAW" />
